title: ageratinastrum fruticosum
intro: Ageratinastrum fruticosum, commonly known as the "Sudan thorn", is a type of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in African folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it an effective remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ageratinastrum fruticosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
